title: Automated Engineering Newsletter
short_desc: An automated weekly newsletter that gathers engineering news and sends it to 190+ colleagues — each receiving only the topics they signed up for.
blueprint_desc: Colleagues submit news through a simple app, and readers pick their topics in another. Every week an automated flow sorts the news into three topic streams, builds a neatly formatted email and sends it out — respecting who has subscribed or unsubscribed.
tech_notes: Engineered a dual-app architecture featuring a Power Apps submission portal for engineering news and a dedicated subscription preference hub for end-users. Built a complex backend Power Automate scheduler that segments news data into 3 distinct content streams, dynamically compiles them into cleanly formatted nested HTML tables, and handles automated weekly distribution while enforcing real-time opt-in/opt-out subscription states.
